name: Fornells de la Selva (Spain)
description: Green field with the three yellow ovens of the arms set two and one in the upper hoist.
history: The flag was approved on 25 June 1993 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 1767 of 7 July 1993; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, green, with the three gold ovens of the arms set 2 and 1 in an imaginary square at the upper hoist of side 1/3 of the height.

features.role: three ovens (forns) set two and one within a square of 1/3 of the height at the upper hoist
